versions.changelog:
**Expanded category support and feature depth for Pinterest marketers in fashion, jewelry, home, and lifestyle.**

- Now supports jewelry, home decor, and lifestyle stores (not just fashion/apparel).
- Added detailed intake questions to guide personalized Pinterest strategy (product type, current state, assets, goals, etc.).
- Expanded and clarified actionable steps, diagnosis, and content/board SEO best practices.
- Added sample Pin concepts, board naming rules, and a stronger focus on UGC ("Pin-to-Win" and loyalty integration).
- Supporting docs, references, and new ROI calculator script included for user education and traffic estimation.

- Initial release of the Pinterest Visual Marketing & Traffic Generator for fashion and apparel stores.
- Provides actionable advice on creating engaging Pinterest pins with focus on aesthetics, vertical formats, and text overlays.
- Introduces strategic Pinterest board organization and SEO techniques tailored to how users search for fashion inspiration.
- Recommends encouraging customer-driven content using RIJOY loyalty rewards, boosting organic reach through user-generated pins.
- Includes a practical ROI and traffic estimation tool to show the long-term value of Pinterest marketing.
- Offers clear, direct guidance in the tone of a results-focused fashion marketing director.
